additional_info.subject: RE: ID0461455-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / P3 170000356] Defective LED light CRM:03042000168
additional_info.body:
Hi,
When the charger is supposed to show green light, its not showing any light. When it’s supposed to show blue (charging) is showing purple light.
So, I guess you could say that the LED works during charging, but not in standby. Since all other LED’s are fine I guess its related to the one LED and not the LED driver.
/Simen
